description: This file defines an abstract class 'PropertiesCondition' that implements Spring's 'Condition' interface. It provides a template for conditional bean configuration based on 'FineractProperties' settings, with an abstract method 'matches' that subclasses should implement to specify the condition logic.

classes.name: PropertiesCondition
classes.description: Abstract class for defining conditions based on Fineract properties within Spring's conditional configuration framework.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Implements Spring's Condition interface; determines whether the condition matches based on the environment. Delegates to an abstract 'matches' method with 'FineractProperties'.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses; contains custom condition logic based on 'FineractProperties'.
